entities.name: Code of Hammurabi
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: One of the oldest known written legal codes (c. 1754 BCE), inscribed on a basalt stele for Babylonian King Hammurabi. Its 282 laws regulate property, trade, family, labor, and criminal behavior, establishing the principle of proportional justice ("an eye for an eye"). It is a foundational document for understanding the origins of legal systems.
